ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white regions to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch located on the medial-proximal region of the left lobe; a vertical white band on the distal edge of the right lobe; remainder of fluke surface exhibits dense black pigmentation with fine white mottling near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-8 pixels along the entire trailing boundary, particularly pronounced on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both trailing edges, tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white protrusions visible on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical dark line on the right lobe's white distal band; complex dark curvilinear markings on the left lobe's white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly distinctive dark curvilinear pigmentation pattern on the left lobe resembling a fish silhouette, featuring a circular 'eye' and 'body' outline.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'fish-shaped' marking on the left lobe serves as the primary unique identifier.
